The seat of power of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Barshnis Choard]] of the [[Shelsha sector/Legends|Shelsha sector]] was a '''palace''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shelkonwa]], the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]].The palace was located in [[Makrin City]], the capital city of [[Shelkonwa]]. The palace had many passages that connected the Governer's office to the outside of the palace. Chief Administrator Vilim Disra also had an office in the palace with passages connecting to the outside. The passages made visitors able to enter without going through security.
